Support (tickets T-J35554 and T-J35690) said they cannot move me back, Grok Bot has no separate allowance, the plan refund still stands as denied, and extra credits are not normally refundable. I filed complaints with the FTC and the Florida Attorney General over the lack of disclosure.

I just want to use the stuff - not have to learn it or understand the technicalities of it, really. I know there are plenty of other folks out there like me, and this review is for you. That was me. But I was already paying monthly for the lowest-tier X Social subscription when a bundle offer became available. I jumped on. It really is like having an army of people you can just tell to do things and it does them. All these little time-consuming, repetitive, frustration tasks that eat up time and rob you of peace, now you can just hand off to the computer to handle. That’s once for all time, by the way. It’s not like you have to tell it day after day. If it’s a daily or weekly thing, you tell it to take care of it on that schedule, and it does. A couple quick examples: 1. I had a bunch of website correction and improvement stuff I’ve been putting off for a good two years, involving design improvements, email consolidations, corrections, and more. I was putting it off because I’m not a programmer or coder. Gettin’ into the meat n’ taters of something like that would have taken me literally two weeks of my time and I would’ve yanked out all my hair by the end. Grok Bot got ‘er done - no joke - in one afternoon while I sat and sipped coffee. No energy or frustration required from me whatsoever. 2. Daily posting and content creation to maintain an active community. Easily swallows up a couple hours of my day to formulate, put together, edit. But I have a ton of notes, videos, images, transcripts over the years. I just pointed Grok Bot to that existing material, said “Come up with a couple of things each day, pair it with images or video clips, add some commentary quoted from my own existing body of work, prepare it for me by 10pm each night for my approval, then post it the next day at a set time.” Done. Because it’s drawing from my own notes, YouTube and podcast transcripts, photographs, videos - what the Bot comes up with is all me. I don’t even have to post or manage the stuff. Grok Bot does it for me. I’m just getting started with this, and to quote Forest Gump, “I’m not a smart man, Jenny.” But I’m smart enough to know this thing is like a newly-discovered super power that you’ve had sitting dormant all this time.

title: Game Changer
body: Grok Bots: The Always-On AI That Actually Lives in Your World Grok Bots aren’t just another chatbot you open, talk to, and close. They’re persistent, long-lived agents that stay with you—keeping memory across every conversation, owning standing responsibilities, and running routines even while you’re away. They share one cloud computer that belongs to you, so they operate inside your real environment: email, calendar, files, repositories, workspaces, and chat tools. What sets them apart is the combination of continuity and autonomy. Each bot remembers context from previous turns, so you don’t constantly re-explain yourself. You can give it a standing duty (“check my inbox every morning and summarize anything urgent,” “monitor this repo and flag important PRs,” “run this research digest every Sunday”) and it will actually do it on a schedule or event trigger without you having to be present. When something needs your attention, it surfaces it; when the work is routine, it just handles it. Because the bots live on your computer and work with the same connected services you use, the handoff feels natural rather than awkward. One-off tasks can still be handled directly, but anything that should persist—recurring checks, ongoing monitoring, multi-step processes that span days—belongs with a bot that won’t forget and won’t need you to restart the conversation every time. The result is less friction and more leverage. Instead of context-switching back into an AI chat every time you need something done, you set the expectation once and the bot carries it forward. It turns Grok from a powerful conversational tool into something closer to a capable teammate that works on your behalf in the background. If you’ve ever wished an AI assistant could remember what you told it last week, own a recurring process, and keep working after you close the tab, Grok Bots deliver exactly that. They’re one of the most practical and genuinely useful advances in personal AI agents right now.
